description: Blocked designated fire exit access corridor due to stacked automobile tires and auto parts pallets.
Absence of certified Type B (CO2 / Dry Chemical) portable fire extinguisher near high-hazard spray paint booth.
Secondary fire exit door on 2nd floor dormitory locked with deadbolt lock during occupied night hours.
Missing emergency lighting fixtures and illuminated directional EXIT signs along hallway corridors.
Excessive accumulation of combustible sawdust without spark-arresting dust collection and ventilation system.
Faded 'NO SMOKING / FLAMMABLE VAPOR' hazard warning signage at fuel dispensing island.
Expired inspection tag on 2 out of 10 stored ABC dry powder fire extinguishers in storage bay B.
